podcast.body: This was the sole official single released from Passengers' album, Original Soundtracks 1. Notably, it featured Italian opera star Luciano Pavarotti on vocals. The song took its name from "The Pillow Book," the fake film for which the Passengers project was originally conceived as a soundtrack. "There was just one official single, and it featured of all people, Italian opera star Luciano Pavarotti. This song took its name from the fake film for which it was written."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
